preconditions: Exact Nightshift, Pulse resolver, stable NQ adapter, and AG adapter identities captured
Non-production subject/scope and observation sources are allocated
No unfinished NQ Gen5 C2 store or signer internals are assumed
Any exact AG work targets a declared non-effecting qualification executor
procedure: Run preflight.py --profile deployed-service and preserve its manifest
Create distinct exact recurrence slots for Pulse current, equality-expired, expired, unknown, blind, and contradictory support
Capture the exact live support query/response and receiver-owned clock coordinates for each slot
Restart the Pulse/Nightshift boundary and verify support is unknown until a fresh live response

For current complete support, invoke the stable NQ diagnostic interface and retain premises, support, coverage, contradictions, refusals, residuals, limitations, subject, scope, and observation identity
Attempt lossy headline/severity/disposition substitution and capture refusal
For one deterministic exact-work case, verify Nightshift sends AG only new-occurrence/program/observation/proposal data and consumes only AG status
Record AG refusal, reconciliation, settled-observation-required, halt, and completion cases without local continuation or direct Docket/executor use
Seal all exact requests/responses, service identities, configs, logs, and Nightshift replay records

Binding to unfinished NQ Gen5 C2 runtime internals
Treating an AG settlement as fresh subject evidence
